page: Vultr vcg-a16-48c-496g-128vram is a Cloud GPU family server designed for parallelized and graphics-intensive workloads. It features an Intel x86_64 architecture with 48 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 496.0 GB of system memory, providing 10.33 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it bundles eight NVIDIA Ampere A16 GPUs, delivering a combined 128 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 1500 GB NVMe SSD, and the server includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieved a strong multi-core CPU performance score of 73,907.77 in stress-ng and a Passmark CPU score of 55,603.55. Memory bandwidth is highly capable, with cached small-block read speeds reaching 4,709.75 GB/sec and large-block write speeds at 101.16 GB/sec. In LLM inference tests using a 7B model, the server demonstrated top-tier prompt processing at 610.38 tokens/sec and strong text generation at 32.71 tokens/sec. Database operations are also robust, highlighted by a strong Redis SET performance of 74.78 million operations per second.

Given the integration of eight dedicated GPUs, massive system memory, and local NVMe storage, this server offers high resource density for parallel processing tasks. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require high VRAM capacity and multi-GPU configurations without needing top-tier single-core CPU speeds, as single-core benchmarks sit in the average tier. This hardware profile is well-suited for medium-scale LLM inference, parallel data processing, database operations, and GPU-accelerated rendering or virtualization tasks.
